limits: Finite corner-mapping rivals, three seeds, four starts and four query rotations only; not universal identifiability.

pre_repair_witness.rival_program:
(rule!
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (body (subgrid g 1 1 (- h 2) (- w 2)))
         (bh (rows body))
         (bw (cols body))
         (hh (quotient bh 2))
         (hw (quotient bw 2))
         (corner (first (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                                (list (list 0 0) (list 0 (- w 1)) (list (- h 1) 0) (list (- h 1) (- w 1)))))))
    (cond [(and (= (first corner) 0) (= (second corner) 0)) (subgrid body 0 0 (- hh 1) (- hw 1))]
          [(= (first corner) 0) (subgrid body 0 0 (- hh 1) (- hw 1))]
          [(= (second corner) 0) (subgrid body hh 0 (- bh 1) (- hw 1))]
          [else (subgrid body hh 0 (- bh 1) (- hw 1))])))
